actual_transfer_faults: software-CP copy scratch allocation after descriptor publication
lifecycle.no_replay_proof: Seeded device destination is read after the injected error and before any replacement write.
lifecycle.rv32_cache_field_clarification: The raw RV32 report configuration.cache_enabled=false denotes disabled compiler caching (CCACHE_DISABLE=1); resolved flags show processor instruction and data caches enabled.

limitations: Only the six declared signatures and exact frozen configurations are accepted.
Native processor RTL bypasses the AFU; integer DPI helpers remain, while tensor/scalar arithmetic uses the named native TFR/STD datapaths.
Trusted compiler-record and byte binding identifies build inputs; it does not authenticate arbitrary hardware or a malicious concurrent filesystem writer.
Mocked device-loss and cleanup-error tests are host-only; actual SimX faults are the specifically injected allocation failures.
Timeouts retain ownership; destruction drains indefinitely if a backend never completes.
No transactional rollback of partially completed DMA or broad physical-device recovery is established.
Device allocator accounting and ownership checks are not an exhaustive process-heap leak measurement.
Tool identities do not inventory every system header, compiler support file or dynamic library.
Evidence stores binary hashes and reproducible source/configuration bodies, not binary replay archives.
P01-A03 vendor integration remains blocked and is required before P07 can close.
not_run: additional model_parity (no successful CP tick or timing behavior changed)
exhaustive host heap leak or physical fault recovery qualification
